Field.name: CommandFile
Field.usage: Command file for reconstruction (with or without extension)
Field.manpage: Command file for reconstruction, which can be entered with or without its extension of ".com". If this option is not entered, a non-option argument is used for the command file.

Field.name: FakeSIRTiterations
Field.usage: List of iteration numbers for runs with SIRT-like filtering
Field.manpage: List of iteration numbers for runs with SIRT-like filtering. Ranges are allowed. An entry for "ExactFilterSize" will be removed from the command file and the high-frequency filtering option will be retained.

Field.name: ExactObjectSizes
Field.usage: List of "object sizes" for runs with "exact filters"
Field.manpage: List of "object sizes" for runs with "exact filters". Ranges are allowed. An entry for "FakeSIRTiterations" will be will be removed from the command file and the high-frequency filtering option will be retained.

Field.name: HammingLikeStarts
Field.usage: Set of frequencies (1/pixel) for start of Hamming-like filter
Field.manpage: Set of starting frequencies, in reciprocal pixels (0 - 0.5) for a Hamming-like filter. An entry for "RADIAL" will be removed from the command file and any options about the initial form of the filter will be retained.

Field.name: GaussianCutoffs
Field.usage: Set of frequencies (1/pixel) for cutoff of Gaussian filter
Field.manpage: Set of frequencies for the cutoff of the standard Gaussian filter, in reciprocal pixels (0 - 0.5). See the rules above for how the cutoff and falloff vary when this option does not have the same number of entries as the \fB-falloff\fR option.

Field.name: GaussianFalloffs
Field.usage: Set of frequencies (1/pixel) for falloff of Gaussian filter
Field.manpage: Set of frequencies for the falloff of the standard Gaussian filter, in reciprocal pixels (0 - 0.5).

Field.name: WidthInX
Field.usage: Width of tomograms to build, in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Width of tomograms to build, in unbinned pixels. The default is to do the whole extent in X. An existing "WIDTH" entry in the command file will be replaced or removed.

Field.name: SizeInY
Field.usage: Size in Y of tomograms to build, in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Size in Y (the Y dimension of the aligned stack) of tomograms to build, in unbinned pixels. The default is to do the whole extent in Y. An existing "SLICE" entry in the command file will be replaced or removed.

Field.name: ThicknessInZ
Field.usage: Thickness of tomograms to make, in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Thickness of tomograms to make, in unbinned pixels. The default is to use the "THICKNESS" entry in the command file.

Field.name: ShiftInX
Field.usage: Shift of tomograms in X, in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Shift of tomograms in X, in unbinned pixels. For this and the other shift entries, a positive shift will bring an area at negative offset to the center. The default is 0 shift; an existing "SHIFT" entry in the command file will be replaced or removed.

Field.name: ShiftInY
Field.usage: Shift of tomograms in Y, in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Shift of tomograms in Y (the Y dimension of the aligned stack), in unbinned pixels. The default is 0 shift.

Field.name: ShiftInDepth
Field.usage: Shift of tomograms in Z (the depth dimension), in unbinned pixels
Field.manpage: Shift of tomograms in Z (the depth dimension), in unbinned pixels. The default is to use the Z shift value from the "SHIFT" entry in the command file, if any.
